title: Dolomites: three summer days
summary: Undated summer example for an experienced mountain walker travelling by car. Start already based in Ortisei; move to Misurina on day 2. Pins identify public lift access, entrances and trail starts. Dwell times are suggestions. Photos and weather are omitted because none were verified for travel dates.
note: Location and source checks: 2026-10-14. Opening hours, prices, queues and conditions for future dates remain unverified. Route estimates exclude traffic and access restrictions. Recheck before travelling.

phases.title: Ortisei and Val di Funes
phases.subtitle: Ortisei base, one night after day 1; arrive before this plan starts.

days.title: Seceda, Alpe di Siusi and Santa Maddalena

stops.name: Seceda: Ortisei lift access
stops.desc: Pin is the public lower station in Ortisei, not the Seceda summit. Suggested duration includes the return lift trip and a short signed-path visit. Place and station checked; travel-date operations, tickets and mountain conditions remain unverified. Skip exposed paths in poor weather.

stops.name: Alpe di Siusi: Ortisei lift access
stops.desc: Pin is the public Ortisei station for Mont Seuc and Alpe di Siusi. Suggested duration includes the return gondola ride and a short plateau visit. Access point checked; lift operations, prices and queues for your date remain unverified. Make this optional if the first lift visit runs late.

stops.name: Santa Maddalena church, Val di Funes
stops.desc: Pin is the mapped main church entrance, reached on foot from permitted village parking. Place identity and entrance checked. Interior opening hours and parking restrictions for your date remain unverified; an exterior visit is the default. Respect worship and private meadows.

tips: Start in Ortisei and return there tonight. Walk between the two lift access points; that walking leg has not been timed. Lift rides are not road-route legs.

OSRM driving check 2026-10-14: Alpe lift access to church vicinity 37.4 min, 34.5 km; return 37.6 min. Budget at least 50 min each way plus legal parking and the church approach. Router snapping does not grant vehicle access to the church. Outbound source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/11.6712802,46.5728649;11.7192024,46.6447496?overview=false

Return source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/11.7192024,46.6447496;11.6712802,46.5728649?overview=false. Suggested visits total 285 min. Allow roughly 100 min driving, 45 min lunch/rest and 45 min approaches and queues, about 8 h overall. Cut Alpe di Siusi if queues threaten 9 h.
Confirm both lifts' opening times and last descent for your date. Do not add summit hikes to this short sightseeing day.
Before any mountain walk, check https://weather.province.bz.it/en/mountain-weather. Any point forecast covers one grid point, not every ridge or path.
Map data: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Road estimates: OSRM demo service, no traffic or closure guarantee.
days.food: Allow a packed lunch or choose a currently open venue after checking its hours.

phases.title: Misurina and the eastern Dolomites
phases.subtitle: Misurina base from day 2; arrange accommodation separately.

days.title: Transfer via Lago di Braies and Tre Cime access

stops.name: Lago di Braies: north shore path access
stops.desc: Pin is the mapped guidepost by the north shore access path near the hotel, not the middle of the lake. Place and approach checked. Suggested short lakeside walk; no full circuit or boat hire is included. Date-specific traffic rules, parking availability and prices remain unverified.

stops.name: Tre Cime trailhead at Rifugio Auronzo
stops.desc: Pin is the mapped guidepost at the hut trail start. Hut identity and trail starting area checked. Suggested short out-and-back on a signed path only after a current conditions check. This is not the complete Tre Cime circuit. Road access, parking reservation, hut hours and trail conditions for your date remain unverified.

stops.name: Lago di Misurina: lakeside path access
stops.desc: Pin is the mapped lakeside footway and wooden path junction. Use legal parking nearby and walk to the shore. Suggested short rest and stroll, not a mountain route. Map location checked; parking rules and local conditions for your date remain unverified.

tips: OSRM driving check 2026-10-14: Ortisei Alpe lift vicinity to Braies 87.3 min, 90.9 km. Budget at least 110 min for this base transfer, then parking. Source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/11.6712802,46.5728649;12.0855429,46.698981?overview=false

Braies to Auronzo vicinity: OSRM 54.1 min, 41.7 km. Budget at least 75 min plus access waits and parking. Source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/12.0855429,46.698981;12.2964808,46.6120305?overview=false
Auronzo to Misurina: OSRM 18.9 min, 7.6 km. Budget at least 30 min. Source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/12.2964808,46.6120305;12.254293,46.5840283?overview=false
Suggested visits total 180 min. With 215 min buffered driving, 45 min lunch/rest and 60 min parking/queues, allow about 8 h 20 min. Drop the short Auronzo walk if waits make the day exceed 9 h.

Check https://www.prags.bz/en and https://pass.auronzo.info/ for your exact date. A router ignores reservation availability, seasonal road closures and parking capacity. Never drive beyond a restriction.

Before the Auronzo walk, check https://www.arpa.veneto.it/dati-ambientali/bollettini/meteo/dolomiti and local trail advice. Any mountain point forecast is one grid point only. Turn back before worsening weather, snow, ice or exposed terrain.
Take lunch and water; hut dining hours are unverified. Rest before driving and finish at the Misurina base.
Map data: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0; https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright. Road estimates: OSRM demo service, checked 2026-10-14.

days.title: Conditional Sorapis hike and recovery by Misurina

stops.name: Lago di Sorapis trailhead at Passo Tre Croci
stops.desc: Pin is the mapped roadside trail-start guidepost east of Passo Tre Croci, not Lago di Sorapis. Cortina tourism describes trail 215 as for experts, with exposed ledges, cables and ladders. Suggested 330 min includes the out-and-back, pauses and lunch. Route description and starting point checked, but current closures, snow and safety are unverified. Go only with suitable experience and current local advice; otherwise replace the hike with an easy lakeside day.

stops.name: Passo Tre Croci: return and rest
stops.desc: Return to the same mapped start after the hike. Rest, drink and assess fatigue before driving. This is a suggested recovery pause, not a booked service or extra hike. Access point checked; legal parking and current conditions remain unverified.

stops.name: Lago di Misurina: optional recovery stop
stops.desc: Return to the mapped lakeside path access near the Misurina base. Optional short stroll only if energy and weather allow. Map point checked; no venue hours, swimming access or parking availability are verified.

tips: OSRM driving check 2026-10-14: Misurina lakeside vicinity to Tre Croci trail start 6.6 min, 6.2 km, and 6.6 min back. Budget 20 min each way plus parking. Outbound source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/12.254293,46.5840283;12.2048658,46.556049?overview=false

Return source: http://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/12.2048658,46.556049;12.254293,46.5840283?overview=false. Road routing only reaches the trailhead and gives no evidence of hike duration, difficulty or safety.

Suggested stops total 390 min, including hike lunch and rest. Add 40 min buffered driving and 60 min parking and delay allowance: about 8 h 10 min. Leave enough daylight for the return and omit the final stroll if needed.

Before setting out, read https://www.arpa.veneto.it/dati-ambientali/bollettini/meteo/dolomiti and get current trail advice. A mountain forecast for one grid point cannot predict conditions on every exposed section. Do not go with snow, ice, thunderstorms, closures or uncertain footing.

Set a turnaround deadline from current daylight and the group's pace before starting. Turn around sooner if anyone is tired or uncomfortable with exposure. Carry water, food, layers and appropriate footwear; seek a qualified guide if technical terrain exceeds your experience.
The lower-risk alternative is a relaxed Lago di Misurina lakeside visit. The full Sorapis hike is conditional, not a confirmed safe activity.

days.food: Carry lunch and snacks; do not rely on an unverified hut opening.
